==Flavor Text==

''Delicate tones of earth and sweetest autumn.''

==About==

A {{i|Spooktacular}} is the product of a first growth stage, third tier {{i|Pumpkin}} Harvest. Additionally a Spooktacular can be grown by Planting another Spooktacular in a {{i|Gardening Pot}}. Planting in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. Right-clicking a Spooktacular and selecting "Slice" will give you 2x {{i|Pumpkin Flesh}} and 6x {{i|Seeds of Pumpkin}}. A Spooktacular can be stored in a {{i|Stockbin}}.
